violation_type.title: Placement of Groups - Groups Kept Separate (26 TAC §746.1505(1))
violation_type.short_title: Placement of Groups - Groups Kept Separate
violation_type.typical_finding: One caregiver was observed supervising two separate room, the caregiver was sitting by the door that separate the rooms. The caregiver was supervising 22 children over the age of 18 months old.

finding_variants.text: One caregiver was observed supervising two separate room, the caregiver was sitting by the door that separate the rooms. The caregiver was supervising 22 children over the age of 18 months old.
Children of mixed ages including infants were combined in one room.

Oberseved infant and toddler area with a removable wall mount division open and accesiible to acces between age groups. Children and caregivers observed to be walking back and forth  through open space of room.
It was observed that 24 children of mixed ages were sharing one open space.
The large classroom was not properly divided allowing children to move freely between the two spaces.

There is a large room that includes two groups of children, but the area is not fully divided in a way that keeps children from mixing together. Toddlers also have to walk through infant space to get to the restroom and changing area.
